Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

metrosp (development version)

Data pipeline

  • The data-raw/ ETL pipeline can now be run as a targets pipeline (targets::tar_make()), replacing the flag-driven run_pipeline.R orchestrator. Pipeline functions live in data-raw/R/; the legacy scripts remain and produce identical output. See CLAUDE.md for the workflow.

Datasets

  • metro_lines$line_number and station_daily$line_number / station_daily$year are now integer (previously double), matching the other datasets. Values are unchanged.

metrosp 1.0.0

CRAN release: 2026-05-05

  • Initial CRAN submission.
